description: enforce_for_delivery in relay_client.rs fetches the DNS TXT record on a cache miss (stored in _txt) but throws it away without storing or comparing the policy_id. RFC 8461 §4.1 requires: if a cached policy exists but the DNS id= has changed, the sender MUST re-fetch. The current implementation uses Instant-based TTL expiry as the only cache invalidation mechanism. If an operator updates their MTA-STS policy mid-TTL (e.g. changing mode from testing to enforce), the old cached policy remains in effect until Instant::now() >= valid_until. Additionally, MtaStsError::PolicyIdMismatch is defined in mta_sts_error.rs but is never produced anywhere in the codebase — dead variant. Fix: on a cache hit, also do a DNS TXT lookup and compare policy_id; if mismatched, invalidate the cache entry and re-fetch.
title: MTA-STS policy cache never invalidated on id= mismatch (RFC 8461 §4.1)
